skill.summary: Theta EdgeCloud API-key-first runtime scaffold with secure command-scoped auth and dry-run safety.

latestVersion.changelog: v0.1.21 adds Qwen3 on-demand chat support with streaming SSE parsing, refreshed live service catalog (Qwen3, MiniMax M2.5, GPT OSS 120B, Llama 3 8B, SDXL Turbo, LLaVA), MCP-compatible THETA_API_KEY alias, and capacity-aware retry/error handling for Theta on-demand 409/504 responses. Qwen3 is documented as beta/intermittent upstream; use parallax_32b_fp8 with streaming and fall back to MiniMax/Llama/GPT OSS when capacity is unavailable.
